Shinny is routed such that you won’t get consistent wind direction.  It may be downwind one hole and then cross wind the next.  

Some courses go out and back in one direction or the other; not Shinnecock. It’s an impeccably routed golf course.


Kingsley Emmanuel (fxking) (@KingsleyEm5618)

Wind can turn a normal course into a nightmare real quick suddenly every shot feels like guesswork. Scores definitely creep up when it’s blowing hard.

It’s the shortest par 5 in American golf.

11, the uphill par 3, was a beast in 2018. It was almost impossible to hold the green. Can’t wait to see how it plays this year, especially in the wind.

Today is Flag Day!
The current design of Florida's state flag was adopted in 1900. Because when furled, the flag lacked color, the 1899 Legislature voted to place a constitutional amendment on the ballot to update the flag. Florida voters approved the change adding the diagonal red bars.  See all of Florida’s State Flags here: dos.fl.gov/florida-facts/flo…
